name: Long Beach City College Individual Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes at Long Beach City College while you are in middle or high school. Students with 12 or more units by senior year can earn a graduation medallion.
who_can_apply: Active middle or high school students who meet each course's prerequisites. No minimum GPA is listed.
pay_detail: Tuition and enrollment fees are free. Course material fees, textbooks and supplies are not covered (a Textbook Loan Program exists for hardship).
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. See the college's Registration Dates and Academic Calendar pages.
how_to_apply: Apply free on OPENCCC. You get your Viking ID by email. Then turn in the High School Dual Enrollment Form with all signatures. Finish New Student Orientation with a score of 80% or higher on the final test. Then register once Admissions confirms your form.
notes: Students who stop attending for two main terms must reapply. Taking college classes does not affect Long Beach College Promise eligibility. To take extra units, file the Unit Max Petition.
